title: MRI-based deep-learning radiomics nomogram for differentiating FIGO 2023 stage I from stage II-IV endometrial cancer: a multicenter study.
summary: A retrospective multicenter study of 1,006 patients reports external-test AUC 0.829 for differentiating FIGO 2023 stage I from stages II–IV endometrial cancer.
organization: The Affiliated Suzhou Hospital of Nanjing Medical University; Suzhou Municipal Hospital; Nanjing Medical University

evidence.tested: A retrospective multicenter study of 1,006 patients reports external-test AUC 0.829 for differentiating FIGO 2023 stage I from stages II–IV endometrial cancer.
evidence.unknown: Classification performance does not establish prospective screening utility or improved patient outcomes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
